title: derm harness presets
description: The preset table, assembled from one file per agent in crates/derm-cli/src/connect/presets/ (index.json names the lists and their order; integration w2). `harnesses` are the rows derm connect writes for (lane C's fields, not all listed here); `planned` are agents derm does not cover yet. Every row carries `coverage` (integration w1, note AQ section 4). Wave 5 (the wave 5 base): `tap`, `kit` and `executables` are merged into rows from the sibling tables in presets/wave5/, one lane's each (S, T, W). Wave 6 (the wave 6 base): `sandbox` is merged from presets/wave6/sandbox.json (lane 6A).

tap.description: How derm run points the agent at the model tap, in its launch environment only (wave 5 lane S; rules cases 113, 116, 127). `via`: `env` sets the variable `name`; `codex-provider` passes a `-c model_providers...` override with `requires_openai_auth = true`; `none` when the agent takes no model base URL, so `intent` says where intent comes from (hooks for Cursor, note AS). null until verified.

kit.description: The sbx kit derm run --boundary sbx passes for the agent (wave 5 lane T; note AM section B.3), as the sbx smoke test found it accepted. `from`: `sbx` for sbx's own kits, `sbx-kits-contrib` for the contributed ones. null where sbx has no kit for the agent.

fullAccess.description: The words the kit's own entrypoint or default command adds that turn the agent's approvals off (rules case 83), a flag or a flag and its value, as the kit's spec.yaml gives them. derm run adds them to the chat's full-access record and sets DERM_FULL_ACCESS=1 under sbx. An empty list: none in the entrypoint (settings files the kit writes are not read). Lane T's request T-5.

executables.description: The agent's executable names (bare names, no path), for the unregistered-agent flag (rules case 122) and the PATH shims derm setup writes (wave 5 lane W).

sandbox.description: How derm run delivers the agent's own sandbox for the Standard tier (wave 6 lane 6A; contracts/sandbox.md; note AZ section 5). `via`: `settings-flag` passes derm's block as its own settings file on the command line (Claude Code `--settings`, note AZ A2 and A10); `config-override` passes it as configuration overrides at the agent's own level (Codex `-c`, A4); `advisory` writes or checks a user file the project can widen (Cursor's sandbox.json, A6), so the tier is not held; `none` where the agent has no sandbox of its own. `underSrt` and `underSbx`: whether the vendor sandbox stays on inside derm's Whole tier (A8: off under srt, on under sbx). null until verified.

covers.description: The agent's tools the vendor sandbox covers, by derm's normalized names (A7: Claude Code's covers bash and monitor only).

toolAliases.description: An agent's own tools under the built-in names the policy's rules use (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `ls`, `grep`, `webfetch`, `websearch`, `todowrite`, and `bash` for a shell also in `shellAliases`). The agent's hook decides on the agent's own name first and on this name only when no rule names the agent's (integration w6's close, E0's R-E0-4; rules case 243).
